source_caption:
The sheer psychological warfare of the baptism scene hinges entirely on Daniel Day-Lewis’s terrifying micro-expressions. As he is forced by his greatest rival to repeatedly scream “I abandoned my child,” Plainview’s performative sarcasm slowly cracks to reveal a fleeting, devastating flash of genuine guilt, brilliantly exposing the broken man beneath the ruthless tycoon.
⠀
There Will Be Blood (2007), directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, starring Daniel Day-Lewis, Paul Dano, Kevin J. O’Connor. A ruthless and violently ambitious silver miner reinvents himself as an oil tycoon, slowly destroying his own humanity in a relentless pursuit of immense wealth.

source_details.title: There Will Be Blood
source_details.synopsis: There Will Be Blood is a 2007 American epic period drama film co-produced, written and directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, loosely based on the 1927 novel Oil! by Upton Sinclair. It stars Daniel Day-Lewis, Paul Dano, Kevin J. O'Connor, Ciarán Hinds, and Dillon Freasier. The film follows silver miner-turned-oilman Daniel Plainview (Day-Lewis) as he embarks on a ruthless quest for wealth during the Californian oil boom in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It has often been considered as one of the greatest films of the 21st century and of all time.
